scope: Actual opt-in RTX 4090 public attention; preceding Python metadata predicate versus combined live native predicate; GPU schedules and arithmetic unchanged

timing_boundary.eager: Complete forward, backward or combined attention including public guards, allocation, launch and synchronization; wall_ms is host elapsed per call, cuda_event_ms separately retained

qualification.sanitizers: Existing exact GPU schedules retain their prior directed and four-tool qualification; no new GPU ownership or synchronization change

archive.scope: Frozen complete task source, commands, stack, reports, actual host binary, loaded GPU binaries, PTX/SASS and Systems captures; raw data retained outside Git

metadata_only_diagnostic.scope: Host metadata function only, no tensor kernels; diagnostic not an application speedup

systems.scope: Forward, preprocessing, joint backward and gradient conversion; profiled durations are excluded from timing medians
